arguments.sql:
WITH sales AS (
    SELECT product_code, COUNT(*) AS row_count, SUM(sold_quantity) AS units,
           MIN(date) AS first_month, MAX(date) AS last_month
    FROM hardware_fact_sales_monthly
    WHERE date >= '2021-01-01' AND date < '2022-01-01'
    GROUP BY product_code
), products AS (
    SELECT p.division, p.product, COUNT(*) AS codes, COUNT(DISTINCT p.variant) AS variants,
           SUM(s.units) AS units, SUM(s.row_count) AS sale_rows
    FROM sales AS s
    JOIN hardware_dim_product AS p ON p.product_code = s.product_code
    GROUP BY p.division, p.product
), ranked AS (
    SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY division ORDER BY units DESC, product) AS position,
           SUM(sale_rows) OVER () AS matched_rows
    FROM products
)
SELECT division, product, codes, variants, units, position, matched_rows,
       (SELECT SUM(row_count) FROM sales) AS source_rows,
       (SELECT MIN(first_month) FROM sales) AS first_month,
       (SELECT MAX(last_month) FROM sales) AS last_month,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) - COUNT(DISTINCT product_code) FROM hardware_dim_product) AS extra_code_rows
FROM ranked
WHERE position <= 4
ORDER BY division, position
LIMIT 30

WITH product_totals AS (
    SELECT p.division, p.product, SUM(s.sold_quantity) AS total_quantity
    FROM hardware_fact_sales_monthly AS s
    JOIN hardware_dim_product AS p ON p.product_code = s.product_code
    WHERE s.date >= '2021-01-01' AND s.date < '2022-01-01'
    GROUP BY p.division, p.product
),
ranked_products AS (
    SELECT total_quantity,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               PARTITION BY division
               ORDER BY total_quantity DESC, product
           ) AS division_rank
    FROM product_totals
)
SELECT AVG(total_quantity) AS overall_average_quantity_sold
FROM ranked_products
WHERE division_rank <= 3
LIMIT 1
